tweet.text:
I've been wondering why there is not a whole of govt/industry push to enlist millions of devs to secure their own software and create best practices and tools for it?  

I don't trust a few thousand "AI Safety" experts to secure much of anything and it feels like most of us are just out here trying to keep from getting hacked while the money flows into a ridiculous endless charade that will never solve the problem.
